properties.value: ECDSA layer of the node's crypto primitives: the crypto_primitives module implements recoverable ECDSA (secp256k1) sign/verify/recover used by the VM's ecrecover precompile path; the multivm testonly site generates P-256 signing keys to exercise the secp256r1Verify precompile; zkstack_cli signs Ethereum transactions with k256; elliptic ships ECDSA to the JS test tooling. properties.value: Key-management infrastructure: the operator signer can delegate operator-key signing to Google Cloud KMS — create_gcp_signer parses a projects/{p}/locations/{l}/keyRings/{r}/cryptoKeys/{k}/cryptoKeyVersions/{v} resource name and builds an alloy GcpSigner over the KMS client.
